'''Kintara''' was a small nation that came into existence after the [[Hundred Years War]].

==Location and mention==
Kintara was probably located in the [[Hills of Kintara]]. It was bordered to the south by Maredo, to the west by Murandy and to the north by Andor. [[Ingtar Shinowa]] mentions Kintara as one of the nations that have fallen into oblivion.{{ref/book|2|10}}
